comments.note: DatabaseBootstrapperMigrationTests.MigratesFrom40To41_AddsOriginalFilenameColumn: DDL auto-commit means test state mutation cannot be wrapped in a transaction. The test does include best-effort recovery (restores db_revision on failure), but if the test process crashes mid-run the column will be absent and revision will be 40 on the next run. A setup guard that checks and restores pre-conditions at the start of the test would make it more resilient to dirty state from a prior failure.

summary: PASS — WP-010 is a test-only work package adding live-DB integration coverage for the m041 migration and GetAllMoviesForObfuscationAsync.

DatabaseBootstrapperMigrationTests (new class in DatabaseBootstrapperTests.cs) correctly uses [Collection("LiveDB")], IClassFixture<LiveDbFixture>, and [SkippableFact]. The migration test simulates pre-m041 state by dropping the column and rolling back revision to 40, runs DatabaseBootstrapper.CheckAsync(), and asserts Status=Ok, ActualRevision=41, and column presence via information_schema.

DDL auto-commit limitation is acknowledged in the doc comment and handled as well as MariaDB allows. Best-effort recovery restores db_revision on failure to prevent cascade test failures. Private LiveDbConnectionFactory nested class is a clean minimal adapter.
GetAllMoviesForObfuscationAsync_ReturnsRowsWithHashAndFilename was pre-existing in DapperMovieRepositoryTests.cs — no new concerns.

comments.note: DatabaseBootstrapperMigrationTests: the `[Collection("LiveDB")]` + `IClassFixture<LiveDbFixture>` + `[SkippableFact]` pattern is consistent with all other live-DB integration tests in the suite. The private `LiveDbConnectionFactory` nested class is a minimal and appropriate adapter — no concerns.

DatabaseBootstrapperMigrationTests.MigratesFrom40To41_AddsOriginalFilenameColumn: the setup block (step 1) is outside the try/catch recovery block. If either ALTER TABLE or UPDATE spdb_config unexpectedly fails during setup, no automatic recovery runs. In practice these operations are near-infallible given a valid DB connection, but wrapping the entire test body (including setup) in try/finally for the recovery logic would make the test fully self-restoring regardless of where failure occurs. Low urgency — both setup statements are safe and use IF EXISTS.

DatabaseBootstrapperMigrationTests: the best-effort recovery only restores `db_revision` to 41 but does not re-add the `original_filename` column in the event that the migration script itself fails. If CheckAsync step 2 fails before the column is added, subsequent tests that rely on the column would be affected. However, this scenario would indicate a real bug in m041 (not in the test) — and the constraints doc already documents the m041 rollback procedure. Acceptable limitation given DDL auto-commit.

ExpectedRevision_MatchesCurrentSchemaRevision test correctly uses the hardcoded literal 41 (not DatabaseBootstrapper.ExpectedRevision) per the INTENTIONAL tripwire comment — this sentinel pattern is well-established in the suite and correctly maintained.
No observations — code is clean and consistent within the constraints imposed by DDL auto-commit in MariaDB.
